questions.stem: Pointing to a man, Rita said, 'His mother is the only daughter of my mother.' How is the man related to Rita?
questions.explanation: 'Only daughter of my mother' = Rita herself. So his mother is Rita → he is Rita's son.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: If A is the brother of B, B is the sister of C, and C is the father of D, how is D related to A?
questions.explanation: A and C are siblings (both have B as sibling). D is C's child → D is A's niece/nephew. Gender of D is not stated so the safest answer is 'niece or nephew'. gender not specified.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Pointing to a photograph, a man said, 'I have no brother or sister, but that man's father is my father's son.' Whose photograph was it?
questions.explanation: 'My father's son' with no siblings = the man himself. So 'that man's father = the speaker' → the photograph is of the speaker's son.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: P is the brother of Q. Q is the brother of R. S is the father of P. How is R related to S?
questions.explanation: P, Q, R are siblings. S is P's father → S is also R's father. R's gender isn't stated, so answer: S's son or daughter. gender of R unknown.
questions.subject: Reasoning

_fixes.was: Son or daughter (gender of R unknown)

questions.stem: In a family, A + B means A is the mother of B; A − B means A is the brother of B; A × B means A is the father of B; A ÷ B means A is the daughter of B. Which expression shows that P is the maternal uncle of Q?
questions.explanation: Maternal uncle = mother's brother. We need P as brother of Q's mother M. P − M (P is brother of M) + M + Q (M is mother of Q) → P − M + Q. Option A captures this relation.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Introducing a woman, a man said, 'Her mother is the only daughter of my mother-in-law.' How is the woman related to the man?
questions.explanation: 'Only daughter of my mother-in-law' = the man's wife. So the woman's mother is the man's wife → the woman is the man's daughter.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Pointing to a photograph, Kavya says, 'This man is the only son of my paternal grandfather.' How is the man in the photograph related to Kavya?
questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.explanation: Paternal grandfather's only son = Kavya's father. So the man is Kavya's Father.

questions.stem: A is the father of B. B is the sister of C. C is the mother of D. How is A related to D?
questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.explanation: A→B (father-daughter), B is sister of C→A is C's father too. C is D's mother → A is D's maternal grandfather.

questions.stem: Rohan says, 'Seema's father is the only son of my mother.' How is Rohan related to Seema?
questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.explanation: My mother's only son = Rohan himself. So Rohan is Seema's father.

questions.stem: Introducing a man to her husband, a woman said, 'His brother's father is the only son of my grandfather.' How is the woman related to the man?
questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.explanation: Only son of her grandfather = her father. Man's brother's father = man's father. So man's father = woman's father → they are siblings. Woman is man's Sister.

questions.stem: P's mother is Q's grandmother. R is P's brother. How is Q related to R?
questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.explanation: Q's grandmother = P's mother means Q is child of P's sibling (aunt/uncle of P) or Q is P's child. Actually: P's mother is Q's grandmother → Q is P's niece/nephew (Q's parent is P's sibling). R is P's brother (P's sibling). So Q is child of P or R's sibling. If Q's parent is a sibling of P, and R is also P's sibling, Q could be R's child (R's son/daughter). So Q is R's child = Son/Daughter.

questions.stem: Four friends A, B, C, D are related. B is the father of A. D is the son of C. A and C are siblings. How is B related to D?
questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.explanation: A and C are siblings → B (father of A) is also parent of C (A's sibling, so B is C's father). D is C's son → B is D's grandfather.

questions.stem: A woman says of a man, 'His mother-in-law is my mother-in-law's daughter.' How is the woman related to the man?
questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.explanation: My mother-in-law's daughter = my sister-in-law (or husband's sister). The man's mother-in-law = that sister-in-law → the man is married to my husband's sister. So the man is my husband's sister's husband → the man is my brother-in-law. Woman is man's Sister-in-law.

questions.stem: If 'A $ B' means A is the father of B, 'A @ B' means A is the wife of B, and 'A # B' means A is the sister of B, what does 'P $ Q # R @ S' mean?

options.option_text: P is the father-in-law of S
P is the uncle of S
P is the grandfather of S

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.explanation: P$Q: P father of Q. Q#R: Q sister of R. R@S: R wife of S. So R is married to S; R is child of P (P is Q's father and Q is R's sister → P is R's father too). R is S's wife → P is S's father-in-law.

questions.stem: Looking at a portrait Ravi says, 'The father of this girl is my father's only son-in-law.' Ravi is a male. What is the girl's relation to Ravi?
questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.explanation: Father's only son-in-law = husband of Ravi's only sister. The girl's father is Ravi's brother-in-law (sister's husband). So the girl is the daughter of Ravi's sister → the girl is Ravi's Niece.

questions.stem: Suresh told Vikas, 'Yesterday I met the only brother of the daughter of my grandmother.' Who did Suresh meet?
questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.explanation: Grandmother's daughter = Suresh's mother or aunt. If 'my grandmother' is paternal: daughters could be Suresh's aunts. The only brother of his grandmother's daughter = his uncle (or his own father if grandmother's daughter = his mother). 'Only brother of the daughter' — if the daughter is his mother, then her only brother is Suresh's maternal uncle. But the question says Suresh 'met' someone, so it's likely his uncle. But a simpler read: grandmother's daughter = his mother; only brother of his mother = his maternal uncle. Answer: His uncle.

questions.stem: Jayesh is Kamla's brother. Sonu is Kamla's mother. Vishnu is Sonu's father. Rekha is Vishnu's mother. How is Jayesh related to Vishnu?
questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.explanation: Kamla's mother is Sonu; Kamla's brother is Jayesh → Jayesh's mother is also Sonu. Vishnu is Sonu's father → Vishnu is Jayesh's maternal grandfather. So Jayesh is Vishnu's grandson.

questions.stem: In a family photo Deepa says, 'This lady is the wife of the grandson of my mother.' Deepa is female. Who is the lady?
questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.explanation: My mother's grandson = Deepa's own son or her sibling's son. The wife of that grandson = Deepa's daughter-in-law (if it's Deepa's son) or nephew's wife (niece-in-law). The lady is Deepa's daughter-in-law or niece-in-law.

questions.stem: Pointing to a man in a photograph, a woman says, 'He is the only son of my mother's mother.' How is the woman related to the man in the photograph?
questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.explanation: My mother's mother = my maternal grandmother. Her only son = my maternal granduncle (my mother's brother, i.e., maternal uncle). So the man is the woman's maternal uncle. The woman is man's Niece.

questions.stem: If X is Y's brother, Y is Z's sister, Z is W's daughter, and W is V's husband, how is X related to V?
questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.explanation: V is W's husband, W is Z's mother. Z is Y's sister. Y is X's sister. So X, Y, Z are all siblings; W and V are their parents. X is V's son.

questions.stem: Sangeeta is the niece of Ashok. Ashok's mother is Kamla. Kamla's husband is Raju. How is Sangeeta related to Raju?
questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.explanation: Sangeeta is niece of Ashok → Sangeeta is child of Ashok's sibling. Kamla (Ashok's mother) and Raju are Ashok's parents. So Sangeeta's parent is Ashok's sibling, and Kamla & Raju are grandparents of Sangeeta → Sangeeta is their granddaughter.
